name: Seductive Symphony
source: Seductive Symphony is a 2D flirting game that will take you on a thrilling journey through 18 unique locations, where you'll meet three intriguing main characters. Although the game lacks animation, the engaging writing style and storyline make up for it
translation: Seitive Symphony是一款2D调情游戏，将带你踏上18个独特地点的惊心动魄之旅，在那里你将遇到三个有趣的主角。虽然游戏缺乏动画，但引人入胜的写作风格和故事情节弥补了这一点
